verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs show first-party block referencing: typing `(())` references a block on any page. References support hover previews, opening in the right sidebar, and custom display labels. This covers the core of referencing an individual block from another note. missing for 10: explicit documentation of block embeds/transclusion and of live sync of referenced content, independent or hands-on corroboration of block-ref behavior.
